params.body:
A task with the term "now" waited in Portal until someone opened Portal. Nothing carried it to the owner: the Android app has no push, and Elixir mails only a job that fails and a site that goes down or comes back. In November the Observatory's first Claude account stood logged out with a "now" task open ("claude a1: OAuth session expired") while the other account carried the week alone, and it was found by chance.

## What changes

- **`NowMail`**, run by `portal:fleet-snapshot` (every fifteen minutes) after the reactor, on the same changes it reads:
  - a task that **opened in "now"**, or **worsened into it**, since the last snapshot is mailed to `portal.owners` (`OWNER_EMAILS`);
  - the mail names the project and task, the verdict, up to four evidence lines and the project's page in Portal; several at once are one mail;
  - **once**: the same task standing open in the next snapshot is not mailed, and a task that closes and opens again within 24 hours is not mailed again, so a flapping measurement cannot fill the inbox;
  - a task a person has taken up or parked is not mailed;
  - a mail that fails to send is retried at the next change, and never fails the snapshot.
- `--no-react` now also mails nobody, as it asks no hand.
- No first-snapshot stampede: like the reactor, nothing is mailed when there is no previous snapshot.

## Tests

- `tests/Feature/NowMailTest.php`, 6 tests, new: an opened "now" task is mailed with its evidence and link; not twice within the quiet window; worsened into "now" says what it was; a "week" task and a held task are not mailed; several are one mail; without an owner nothing is sent and nothing is kept quiet.
- `php artisan test`: 779 of 780. The one failure is `BuildStampTest`, which fails only in a git worktree. Pint passes.

## On the box

Nothing new: it sends through the mailer the login link already uses, to `OWNER_EMAILS`.
params.title: Mail the owner once when a task opens in now
